# Test media attribution

These files are development fixtures, not shipped extension assets. They retain
their original licenses; the project license does not replace those licenses.

| Files | Origin and license | Changes |
|---|---|---|
| bus.jpg | [Ultralytics assets](https://github.com/ultralytics/assets/blob/main/im/bus.jpg), [AGPL-3.0](https://github.com/ultralytics/assets/blob/main/LICENSE) | Upstream JPEG; SHA-256 `c02019c4979c191eb739ddd944445ef408dad5679acab6fd520ef9d434bfbc63`. |
| bus.mp4, bus-long.mp4 | Local video fixtures derived from the bus photograph; same upstream attribution/AGPL license | Encoded short clips used to exercise moving/sampled media. They are not independent real-world video benchmarks. |
| woman-profile.jpg | Pedro Ribeiro Simões, [Woman profile portrait](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Woman_profile_portrait_(26138832421).jpg), [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) | Downloaded/resized JPEG used for a side-facing crop. |
| man-profile.jpg | Pedro Ribeiro Simões, [Man profile portrait](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Man_profile_portrait_(5652920331).jpg), [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) | Downloaded/resized JPEG used for a side-facing crop. |

The full GNU AGPL and Creative Commons license texts are in LICENSES/. Portrait
classifier labels are fallible visual estimates, not claims about identity or
self-identified gender. Screenshots containing these photographs retain this
attribution. Documentation coverage screenshots are generated by Sitr from the
bus fixture with Everyone selected and local masking applied.

The previous Lena fixture has been removed from the public source distribution
because the project had no documented redistribution grant for it. Historical
benchmark reports may still mention it; current probes use the attributed media
above. Existing historical throughput numbers used a different fixture mix.
